speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Artificial reefs could transform parts of the wind park into valuable marine habitat.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: The structures could provide shelter and breeding grounds for fish and other marine species.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: This could also create new opportunities for our communities.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The reefs could support species such as oysters and mussels, while increasing fish populations around the wind park.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: However, we would need to adapt our fishing techniques to make use of these new opportunities.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This approach could therefore benefit both marine biodiversity and the livelihoods of the fishing communities.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: It supports SDG 14 while also contributing to SDGs 1, 2 and 8.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The artificial reef approach addresses the impacts of the wind park without relocating the project, although the fishing communities will still need to adapt.
